**<sub><sub>![P1 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P1-orange?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Keep the model secret out of PR-controlled workflows**

For a same-repository PR, an author can modify this local reusable workflow—or the caller itself—to run arbitrary steps while it receives `RONDA_MODEL_API_KEY` and a write-capable token, allowing credential exfiltration before review. [GitHub’s reusable-workflow documentation](https://docs.github.com/en/actions/how-tos/sharing-automations/reusing-workflows#calling-a-reusable-workflow) specifies that the `./...` form resolves the called workflow from the same commit as the caller, so checking the Ronda source out from `main` does not protect the workflow definition. Invoke only a trusted workflow definition and avoid exposing the secret to PR-controlled YAML, or place it behind an approval-protected environment.
